FIELD_TYPES.DEFINITION_PATH: normalized repository path under NEXY-BUILD-CONTROL but outside NEXY-BUILD-CONTROL/FINDINGS
FIELD_TYPES.EVIDENCE_BLOB_SHA: lowercase 40-hex Git blob SHA observed when locator was admitted; generation MUST re-resolve the pinned snapshot blob

LOCATOR_SCHEMA.SORT: FINDING_ID UTF-8 bytes, then DEFINITION_PATH UTF-8 bytes
LOCATOR_SCHEMA.DUPLICATE_RULE: Duplicate FINDING_ID or DEFINITION_PATH is invalid.

VALIDATION: Every locator ID and path is unique.
At generation time the definition path MUST exist in the pinned control tree.
The re-resolved blob MUST parse under Universe V3 RAW_EXTRACTION and expose exactly the locator FINDING_ID.
The basename stem MUST equal FINDING_ID.
Locator metadata never changes severity/status/type semantics.
A locator does not make an unreviewed or malformed external definition valid; any mismatch blocks universe completeness.
